preconditions.description: The number of lines n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(op in {'&', '|', '^'} and 0 <= x <= 1023 for op, x in commands)
preconditions.description: Each command consists of a valid bitwise operation ('&', '|', '^') and a constant x between 0 and 1023 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The length of the output program k is between 0 and 5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(op in {'&', '|', '^'} and 0 <= x <= 1023 for op, x in output_commands)
postconditions.description: Each output command consists of a valid bitwise operation ('&', '|', '^') and a constant x between 0 and 1023 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(same_output(x, commands) == same_output(x, output_commands) for x in range(1024))
postconditions.description: The output program produces the same result as the input program for all integers x from 0 to 1023 inclusive.
